search_updates.found: TRUE and externally confirmed: Gender Recognition Act 2009 (c.11) gives legal gender recognition; Equality Act 2017 phased in, largely in force 1 Jan 2019, lists gender reassignment among protected characteristics. Neither statute is backed by any packet source - must be added in rework.

Male same-sex activity remained a criminal offence on the island until September 1992 (NOT decriminalised in the 1980s as assumed in review; 1983=Guernsey, 1980=England/Wales/Scotland dates). Age of consent 21 from 1992, equalised 16 via Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2006. Rework must date the local criminalisation history correctly.
